form281VersusForm281E.question: Does the drop supply FORM-281, the current Family Court primary petition?
form281VersusForm281E.form281Status: unmanifested; the Family Court primary-filing component still has no correct document to bind

form281E.note: The supplied 281E is byte-identical to the row the adopted edition already retains, digest and byte count both. It is historical evidence of the extension sheet and nothing more.

substitutionRefusedGrounds: Role. A charge extension sheet attaches to a petition and does not commence a proceeding.
Currency. 281E carries an index revision of 09/21/2018; the Family Court petition FORM-281 carries 11/26/2025.
Identity. FORM-281 is a distinct document with its own number and its own index row.
The supplied 281E hashes identically to the row already retained, so it supplies nothing new and certainly not a petition.

titleTrapRecorded.trap: CIV_EXP_02_A is titled Petition for Expungement of Adult Record, and FORM-281 carries the same title in the Family Court. A resolver searching by title alone would find the Superior Court petition and bind it to the Family Court primary-filing slot.
titleTrapRecorded.distinguishingFact: The court. CIV_EXP_02_A captions itself The Superior Court of the State of Delaware; FORM-281 is a Family Court document.
titleTrapRecorded.consequence: CIV_EXP_02_A may not satisfy the Family Court primary-filing component, and FORM-281E may not satisfy it either. Two different documents, two different reasons, one empty slot.

licensing.affirmativeEvidence: All three supplied Delaware PDFs are encrypted with AES-256 and carry issuer-set permissions of copy:no and change:no. That is the issuer technically restricting extraction and modification of these documents. It is evidence against unrestricted reuse, not evidence for it.
licensing.consequence: Delaware generation stays fail-closed. The encryption also means a prefill or overlay lane cannot be assumed to work on these binaries at all, which is a technical finding separate from the legal one.

rendererLaneMeasured.detail: The factory's own PDF inspector cannot read any of the three. Each aborts on an invalid object reference before reporting a structure class, page geometry or field inventory. `pdfinfo` reads the encryption dictionary and reports an AcroForm is present, but the field inventory the inspector needs is not reachable through the encryption.
rendererLaneMeasured.finding: This is measured, not predicted: neither renderer lane can consume these binaries as supplied. A field map cannot be drafted from a file whose fields cannot be enumerated, so the technical blocker stands on its own and would survive even if the licence question were answered tomorrow.
rendererLaneMeasured.doNotDecryptOrRepack: Stripping the issuer's encryption to make the binaries readable would defeat a restriction the issuer set deliberately, and the repacked file would no longer be the issued document. Not done.

evidenceOnlyRetention.reason: The governance model retains evidence-only assets. These are retained as exact measured evidence under external custody with generationAllowed false and implementationAssignable false.

terminalDispositionDetail: The two Superior Court orders corroborate their assigned revisions from their own faces. The Superior Court petition is measured but carries no extractable revision because the issuer encrypted it. CIV_EXP_02_B and FORM-281 are absent and their blockers are preserved unchanged.
expectedDownstreamEffect: Three Delaware identities move from unmanifested to exactly measured under hash-verified external custody, and the Form 281 versus 281E guard gains a second failure mode that had not been recorded: the Superior Court petition shares the Family Court petition’s exact title. No receipt is created, no binary enters version control, no component is rebound, no memo is edited, no edition is published, no packet becomes generatable, no runtime is enabled, no track changes promotion state, and the Delaware official-PDF family stays fail-closed.
